texts.text: Find the Right Screw for Your Application
Get a quick overview of direct assembly screws and learn which one to use for which application.
Different Types of Direct Assembly Screws
At Bossard, we distinguish between different types of screws for direct assembly:
Self-drilling screws require no pre-drilling, which makes them ideal for quick and efficient installation.
Thread-cutting screws create a mating thread in hard materials while still requiring only a low installation torque.
Thread-forming screws are optimal for high clamp load and providing vibration resistance.
Multifunctional screws with integrated washers provide increased security while enabling you to reduce C-parts.
Screws for MetalALtracs® PlusThread-forming screws for light metal alloys and other non-ferrous metals such as zinc, copper, or brass.
Thread-forming screws for light metal alloys and other non-ferrous metals such as zinc, copper, or brass.
Screws for PlasticDelta PT®Self-tapping screws for thermoplastics. High strength and vibration resistance. Ideal for lightweight applications.
Self-tapping screws for thermoplastics. High strength and vibration resistance. Ideal for lightweight applications.
Screws for MetalDIN 7500ISO metric thread-forming screw that optimizes both technical performance and cost-effectiveness.
ISO metric thread-forming screw that optimizes both technical performance and cost-effectiveness.
Screws for Metalecosyn® drillSelf-cutting screws made from case-hardened steel. Easy one-step assembly.
Self-cutting screws made from case-hardened steel. Easy one-step assembly.
Screws for Metalecosyn® IMXThread-forming screws for stainless steel. High corrosion resistance.
Thread-forming screws for stainless steel. High corrosion resistance.
Screws for Metalecosyn® MRXSelf-cutting screws for sheet metal construction. High corrosion resistance.
Self-cutting screws for sheet metal construction. High corrosion resistance.
Self-tapping screws for process-safe and easy fastening into thermoplastics. Excellent load-bearing capacity for a reliable connection.
Screws for MetalEJOT FDS®Flow drill screws ideal for joining thin sheets of steel or aluminum without component preparation such as pre-drilling or punching.
Flow drill screws ideal for joining thin sheets of steel or aluminum without component preparation such as pre-drilling or punching.
Screws for PlasticEJOT PT®Self-tapping screws for thermoplastics. The classic solution for plastic applications.
Self-tapping screws for thermoplastics. The classic solution for plastic applications.
Screws for MetalEJOT SHEETtracs®Self-tapping screws designed for thin sheet metals. High-strength, reliable assembly, vibration resistant.
Self-tapping screws designed for thin sheet metals. High-strength, reliable assembly, vibration resistant.
Screws for PlasticEVO PT®Self-tapping screws for thermoplastics. High process safety and consistent installation torque.
Self-tapping screws for thermoplastics. High process safety and consistent installation torque.
Screws for WoodSpax®Screws for diverse indoor and outdoor applications, as well as timber construction and window systems.
Screws for diverse indoor and outdoor applications, as well as timber construction and window systems.
Screws for MetalTaptite 2000®Thread-forming screws with outstanding mechanical, fastening and ergonomic characteristics.
Thread-forming screws with outstanding mechanical, fastening and ergonomic characteristics.
Screws for ConcreteTecfi®Concrete screws and bolt anchors. High load-bearing capacity in cracked and non-cracked concrete.
Concrete screws and bolt anchors. High load-bearing capacity in cracked and non-cracked concrete.
Wall AnchorsTox®Anchoring systems, wall plugs, and insulation fasteners. Sealing plugs for wet areas.
Anchoring systems, wall plugs, and insulation fasteners. Sealing plugs for wet areas.
The products listed here may not be available in all countries. In case of questions, please contact us.
